correctness.rationale: For iid cycles with Exp(1) run/rest marginals and fresh fair run signs, stationary same-run sampling yields E[W0 Ws]=v² E[(U-s)+]/E(U+V)=v² exp(-|s|)/2, so the full lag-MSD v²(t−1+exp(−t)) is unchanged by pairing. The analytic regenerative characteristic exponent solves E[exp(−lambda(U+V))cosh(kvU)]=1: the k⁴ coefficient has 24B=v⁴/E(T)[E(U⁴)−6 E(U²)/E(T) E(U²T)+3(E(U²)/E(T))² E(T²)]. With both margins Exp(1), comonotone pairing gives cumulant rate −12v⁴, countermonotone pairing gives (π²+12ζ(3)−24)v⁴/2, and the Bernoulli pairing mixture is affine, crossing once at θ=24/(π²+12ζ(3)). Exact logarithmic beta integrals E(UV)=2−ζ(2), E(U²V)=6−2ζ(2)−2ζ(3) give the endpoint constants. Independent direct high-precision integration confirms the two endpoint coefficients and θ≈0.98788656624871, and the rational bound π>157/50 plus five zeta-series terms establishes strict positivity. Renewal analyticity/nonarithmetic finite exponential moments justify differentiation of leading log-MGF through fourth order; unfinished boundary cycles do not alter rates. The supplementary finite root checks cannot prove this infinite-time theorem.
